chapters.headline: The board as of Thursday morning
points: Spoken edition of the Signals board; data as of 1:19 AM ET, Thursday, October 22, 2026
37 items across five lanes; the newest items are dated Wednesday, October 21
Three lanes have new items; OT cybersecurity has none since October 20, and AI, standards & research has been quiet since October 8
chapters.takeaway: Everything in this briefing traces to the snapshot on the page below it: headlines, sources, and dates only.

chapters.headline: Three new items, all from Wednesday
points: Three items dated October 21, including Automation Alley on Praxis Business Brokers guiding manufacturing business transitions
Manufacturing Dive: Apple adds iPhone component and materials makers to its US supplier network (October 21)
Manufacturing Dive: the US faces national security risks without aluminum smelters, per a report (October 21)
chapters.takeaway: All three of the lane's new items are dated the same day — Wednesday, October 21.

chapters.headline: September totals, two new items
points: Michigan manufacturing employment: 584.8k in September 2026, down 1.7k on the month (BLS)
Unemployment 5.0% (flat on the month); labor force 4.83 million
Two new items (October 21): the Praxis Business Brokers piece, and a Dakkota Integrated Systems closure in Detroit — 397 jobs, effective December 31
chapters.takeaway: September's totals are close to flat, and the lane's big new item is a Detroit closure notice dated to the end of the year.

chapters.headline: No new advisories since Tuesday
points: No new items since yesterday's edition; the lane's newest advisories are dated October 20
October 20: HMS Networks PEAK-System PCAN Windows drivers; Moxa AIG-302 ThingsPro Edge
October 20: Hitachi Energy MicroSCADA X SYS600 Product; Hitachi Energy RTU500 Product
chapters.takeaway: No new advisories today — Tuesday's four stand at the top of the lane, and the check-your-equipment advice stands with them.

chapters.headline: The quiet lane
points: Quiet lane: the newest item is dated October 8 — NIST joins a White House science effort
September 18: NIST awards more than $1.7 million for cybersecurity workforce development across 8 states
September 17: NSF invests in translating low-dimensional semiconductor technologies
chapters.takeaway: No new standards or research items since October 8 — the lane to watch for a change of pace.

chapters.headline: Four award notices join the board
points: Four federal award notices are new on the board since yesterday's edition, dated October 20 and October 19
Department of Veterans Affairs awards to TRILLAMED LLC: $757K and $736K (October 20); to ALLIANT ENTERPRISES, LLC: $31,050 (October 20)
General Services Administration award to FORD MOTOR CO: $47,395 (October 19)
chapters.takeaway: The lane's news is award notices — three dated October 20 and one dated October 19, all newly on the board since yesterday's edition.

chapters.headline: Dates ahead on the board
points: HealthEdge's Detroit layoff takes effect December 1 (53 jobs); Dakkota Integrated Systems' Detroit closure, December 31 (397 jobs)
The AI, standards & research lane has been quiet since October 8
Manufacturing and Michigan posted new items dated October 21; the next snapshot shows whether that pace holds
chapters.takeaway: The board is the record — this briefing only reads it back.
